newsitem.title: USA: Texas Utils sees Comanche nuke on line Wed..
newsitem.headline: Texas Utils sees Comanche nuke on line Wed..

text.p: Texas Utilities Co's 1,150 megawatt (MW) Comanche Peak nuclear power unit 2 should synchronize to the electricity grid Wednesday afternoon following repairs, a company spokesman said.
The unit, in Glen Rose, Texas, was in a restart mode as of early Wednesday afternoon but had not yet linked to the power grid, spokesman Eric Schmitt said.
"We expect it to synchronize to the grid later this afternoon," Schmitt said Wednesday.
Comanche Peak 2 was shut Saturday for the repair.
The nearby Comanche Peak unit 1, also with a capacity of 1,150 MW, continued to operate normally at full capacity.
The Comanche Peak units produce about 18 percent of Texas Utilities' electricity deliveries.
